Plot a digitized / reconstructed fish

Source: R/visualize.R
plot_landmarks.Rd

Draws the landmarks and the 11 segments of one specimen. With ggplot2 available it returns a ggplot object; otherwise it draws with base graphics.

Usage

plot_landmarks(
  x,
  specimen = 1,
  label_points = TRUE,
  segments = TRUE,
  engine = c("ggplot2", "base"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A fishmorph_landmarks object.

specimen

Which specimen (name or index) to draw. Default first.

label_points

Annotate landmark numbers (default TRUE).

segments

Draw the 11 segments (default TRUE).

engine

"ggplot2" (default when available) or "base".

...

Ignored.

Value

A ggplot object (invisibly for base).
